message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking, but it’s done on a regular schedule. The tower is repainted every seven years to protect its iron structure from rust, and the actual painting process typically takes **about two months**. During this time crews work on all exposed surfaces—roughly 18,000 individual parts—using specialized equipment and protective gear. So, if you’re wondering how long a single painting cycle lasts, the answer is roughly **two months**.
